english_verification.review_scope: Read the J33 configuration, formation decision and representative current English mission prose. Read Lake Federation opening and constitutional-history chunks. Native ideas were compared by key. No exhaustive mission or runtime-reachability audit. Primary compared all native idea names/descriptions by actual current English localisation key. Source ranges may be locator envelopes; conditional and predecessor idea sets remain separate. No formal validators, tests, builds or browser checks were run.
unresolved: The Wiki 1441 ratification and 1625 unification chronology is setting history, not a fixed in-game formation date.

The Chinese overview stresses inclusion while current J33_wrong_world_desc calls for removing centaurs from Halann. That text is a specific counterpoint; execution conditions and consequences were not traced exhaustively, and the inherited value score remains unchanged pending separate review.
The inherited global_colonial_growth +1500% display has raw value 15; its display unit is not certified by this translation.
The six constitutional options and inherited 60 direct mission count were not re-counted or tested in game.

rationale.campaign_length: 60 direct J33 missions; shared Federation prerequisites are counted separately.
rationale.colonization: Expansion onto the plains beyond the three lakes and into colonies occupies part of the campaign.
rationale.complexity: Constitutions, factions, cohesion, parliament and subject systems overlap.
rationale.dark_story: There are crises and coercive wars, but horror is not the central narrative.
rationale.difficulty: A long prologue and complex systems raise the learning cost; difficulty was not quantified through playtesting.
rationale.diplomacy: Competition for Federation leadership, alliances and democratic subjects are central.
rationale.early_pressure: Pre-unification crises and leadership competition impose significant gates.
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: Kalyin Worship and magical materials matter to the setting, but politics and engineering dominate the core campaign.
rationale.narrative_density: The transition from a crisis-ridden league to a global republican project has clear turning points.
rationale.tall_play: Parliament, workshops and lake-region production support expansion.
rationale.trade_economy: Industry, trading fleets, resources and global-market missions are prominent.
rationale.warfare: Exporting democracy after unification and warfare across the plains operate on a huge scale.

identity.appearance: In 1444 this is a league of lake city-states, not unified J33; an eligible member forms J33 after meeting constitutional and leadership conditions.
identity.formation_scope: A member must lead the Federation, follow Kalyin Worship and satisfy constitutional, cohesion and other conditions; kalsyto_nation changes the Tag to J33.
predecessors: Any eligible member city-state of the Lake Federation

national_ideas.scope_note: National traditions, seven national ideas and ambition only; optional idea groups and racial/government bonuses are excluded. Conditional alternatives are separate, not stacked. Adopting new ideas depends on the actual event/decision and player choice.

description.text: With our people united in purpose and spirit, we are ready to retake our ancient homelands in the plains, and to expand our grand union to lands beyond.
description.text_en: With our people united in purpose and spirit, we are ready to retake our ancient homelands in the plains, and to expand our grand union to lands beyond.

description.text: The Joglik Uts, with their legendary ability to secure our homes from the centaurs over the centuries, have greatly inspired the military practices the Federal Guardsmen now use. The preservation of life is highly prioritized within our ranks, and in more recent years the Orachav have enabled us to adapt to the steppe whcih contrasts greatly from Yarikhoi.

description.text: The formerly disunited and selfish trade leagues of the cities have been centralized into a single department, ensuring our merchants are fully capable of directing trade to our bustling markets.

description.text: When our ancestors overthrew the Tyrant Queen, they did not seek to make history. Nonetheless it was with her fall that some of the first republics in the world were founded as the bounds of monarchism were cast down. While others may predate the Day of Ashen Skies, none still remain to contest our legacy as the longest enduring democratic tradition.

description.text: Many other countries ask what the price of a mile is, a way to discourage war and the ensuing devastation. Our soldiers however know damn well what the price is and are ready to pay it tenfold for the glory of the Federation.

description.text: Our greatest academies have joined together into a unified scholarly institution, encouraging the education of our people and studies of the world.

description.text: Even as our borders stretch far beyond the horizon we must not forget the waters that protected us from the centaurs and allowed our cities to thrive. We are the children of the lakes, and masters of the seas.

player_overview.avoid_if: Avoid if you dislike long pre-unification waiting, political controls and large-scale late-game expansion.
player_overview.how_it_plays: Build Federation standing and cohesion, form J33, then balance parliamentary reform, industrial economics and intercontinental war.
player_overview.overview: Begin as a member city of the Lake Federation and become its leader through federal politics, religious crises and constitutional competition; only unification creates J33. Manage parliamentary factions and six constitutional options, using industry, firearms, trade and autonomous democratic subjects to spread the anti-tyrant ideal beyond the lakes. It is a lengthy campaign that grows ever larger.
player_overview.recommended_for: Players who enjoy federal politics, institutional simulation and an exceptionally long republican campaign.
signature_features: Federation membership and the unified J33 state are separate stages.
Six constitutional options, parliamentary factions and political issues.
60 dedicated J33 missions, progressing from lake defence to exporting democracy.
player_overview.tagline: Unify a league of lake cities into a republic, then export democracy to the world.

reasons: A rare progression from federal politics to a global republican project
Parliament and constitutions give campaigns different developmental priorities
warnings: Religious and constitutional paths can change the conditions
The late-game mission workload is substantial

positive_indicators: Missions explicitly advance poverty relief and public welfare
Recognises sapient peoples regarded as monstrous
values.rationale: The inherited assessment cites specific missions for poverty relief, opposition to slavery, protection of the vulnerable and recognition of peoples deemed monstrous; parliament is not an automatic positive. Exporting republicanism by force lowers restraint. The current Wrong World prose also explicitly calls for removing centaurs from Halann; that tension is flagged for separate research review, not used to change the frozen score in translation.
red_flags: Spreading institutions by force involves coercion
